title: ReplicaSet cannot create pods because the namespace quota is full

root_cause.summary: ResourceQuota team-quota limits the namespace to 2 pods, but the deployment asks for 5, so the ReplicaSet gets FailedCreate (exceeded quota) for the rest.

required_evidence: ReplicaSet events show FailedCreate with 'exceeded quota: team-quota'
ResourceQuota team-quota has pods hard limit 2 with 2 used
Deployment desires 5 replicas but only 2 pods exist
red_herrings: There are no Pending pods; the missing pods were never created, so the scheduler is not involved
fix: Raise the pods quota, or reduce the deployment replica count to fit within it.
